1: I thank Thee, O Lord, for Thou hast not abandoned the fatherless nor despised the needy. For Thy might is with the humble of heart.

Thou hast freed my soul from the snares of the pit, and Thou hast raised me up to everlasting heights. I walk on limitless level ground, and I know there is hope for him whom Thou hast shaped from dust for the eternal council.
2: Thou hast made me a banner for the chosen of holiness, and an interpreter of knowledge concerning the mysteries of wonder.
These things I know through Thy understanding, for Thou hast opened my ears to wondrous mysteries, and I am a man of no account.
3: All the foundations of my being chastise me, and my bones are shaken because of my grief, for I am a source of strife to the builders of the wall.
They are the assembly of wickedness, and their congregation is violence; they have no mercy on the poor and no comfort for the broken of spirit.
